scenario.summary: Guest quick order: a SKU shows its suggestion, the same SKU with '2345' appended is rejected on blur; a SKU confirmed via the suggestion is added to the cart; a CSV of 7 valid SKUs fills the Quick List; a CSV with one valid and one invalid SKU gives the partial message (1 added, 1 invalid).
steps: Guest session; open the multi-row pad; enter the suggest product SKU; check the suggestion '<name> | <sku>'
Enter '<sku>2345' (no match); blur; check 'The entered SKU is invalid.'; clear the row
Type the cart product SKU; check the suggestion '<name> | <sku>'; select it; Add to Cart; check the heading 'Cart' and a cart line; clear the cart
Open Paste Multiple; upload the 7-SKU CSV; check '7 Products were added to your 'Quick List'.' and row 0 = first CSV SKU

Go home; open Paste Multiple; upload the one-valid-one-invalid CSV; check the alert contains '1 Product was added to your 'Quick List'.' and 'invalid' (recorded full message is best-effort, logged on drift)
stateChanges: Guest cart gets one product and is cleared
The guest Quick List is filled from two uploaded CSVs (nothing ordered)
assertions: Row error 'The entered SKU is invalid.' for '<sku>2345' on blur
Cart heading 'Cart' and a cart line visible
Alert '7 Products were added to your 'Quick List'.'; row 0 = first CSV SKU
Alert contains '1 Product was added to your 'Quick List'.' and 'invalid'
evidence: Title and the four step labels match the flow; guest storageState; no linked cases. The spec has a MAINTENANCE NOTE (last run failed on the blur validation): evidence only.

suggestProduct -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 1 (only typed for the suggestion, never added), store MaxwellsHardware; preferred sku11 z-2100025 (profile: active SimpleProduct, inventory 1000, but 1 required add-on and storefront index 0, so it fails the key; the resolver falls back). sku11 -> sku, sku11Name = `${name} | ${sku}`. The rejected value `${sku}2345` is derived in the spec from the resolved SKU (a non-existent SKU, nothing to resolve).

cartProduct -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 1, store MaxwellsHardware; preferred sku12 z-4567890 (profile: active SimpleProduct, inventory 9999867, storefront index 1). sku12 -> sku, sku12Name = `${name} | ${sku}`.

Needs csvProduct1..csvProduct7 -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 1 (assumed 1 per row; confirm column layout and quantity), store MaxwellsHardware, distinct records. The migrated spec writes the CSV at run time from csvProduct1..7 in order and builds '7 Products were added…' from the row count; firstCsvSku -> csvProduct1.sku.

Need csvValidProduct -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 1, store MaxwellsHardware (any sellable product keeps the row valid; no scan source, so no preferred). The invalid row is a non-existent SKU, generated by the test (z-100000 exists as a configurable parent; a generated SKU makes the rejection independent of product type). The CSV is written at run time: valid row first, then the invalid row.

csvFile7 / csvFileInvalid file names -> config (the migrated spec writes its own files). Messages are expected-output; '1 Product was added…' and 'invalid' are spec literals; uploadInvalidSkuCSVValidation is the recorded full message (best-effort, drift only logged).
